entry.title: New: Resolution 586 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 586-26 & FC-157 - 07/08/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PLANNING DEPARTMENT TO AWARD FUNDS TO PŌHAKU PELEMAKA THROUGH THE KĪLAUEA RECOVERY GRANT PROGRAM

Provides $142,000 in grant funds to Pōhaku Pelemaka to provide relief, recovery, mitigation, and long-term resilience for disaster damages, losses, and suffering caused by the 2018 Kīlauea eruption.
